subject: English
subskill: Meaning of Word in Literary Prose
passage: The following text is from Celeste Ng's 2020 novel Our Missing Hearts. Two of the narrator's close friends have decided to move to California to work in the technology industry. Another friend has decided not to accompany them. After weeks of discussion, Maya had abandoned the idea of joining them in Silicon Valley. I think she did not want to pursue their path, and she was determined to stay true to her own ambitions.
prompt: As used in the text, what does the word "pursue" most nearly mean?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. In this context, 'pursue' means to take on or follow a particular course of action. The text states Maya 'did not want to pursue their path' and 'had abandoned the idea of joining them,' indicating she chose not to adopt their career direction in technology. 'Adopt' captures this sense of embracing or taking on a particular lifestyle or career path.
